raw_text:
name: python-patterns
description: Python decision-making: frameworks, async, typing, structure. Think, don't copy.
allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep
ASK user for framework preference when unclear
Choose async vs sync based on CONTEXT
Don't default to same framework every time
Choose framework based on context
Ask about async requirements
Use Pydantic for validation
Separate concerns (routes → services → repos)
Test critical paths
I/O-bound → async; CPU-bound → sync + multiprocessing. Never mix sync/async carelessly, use sync libraries in async code, or force async for CPU work.
FastAPI: APIs/AI; Django: full-stack/admin; Flask: simple/scripts. Async for I/O/concurrency; sync for CPU/blocking libraries.
Use type hints for public APIs; infer local variables. Use Pydantic for API models.
Separate routes, services, models, schemas, dependencies. Keep business logic out of routes; handle errors safely without exposing stack traces.
Tests: pytest; integration: httpx/TestClient; E2E: pytest + DB.
Default to Django for simple APIs (FastAPI may be better)
Use sync libraries in async code
Skip type hints for public APIs
Put business logic in routes/views
Mix async and sync carelessly
